section.title: Where shipping rates come from
section.scenario: A checkout service quotes shipping for each order. Each carrier has its own rate rule.
section.question: The team adds a new carrier every month. Which piece fits this system better, and which fact decides it?
section.piece_b:
class ShippingQuote
  def initialize(carrier)
    @carrier = carrier
  end

  def cost_cents(order)
    case @carrier
    when "ups"   then UpsRate.new.cost_cents(order)
    when "fedex" then FedexRate.new.cost_cents(order)
    else raise KeyError, @carrier
    end
  end
end
